mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( pay_merchant_uid, pay_pg_tid, pay_imp_uid, pay_email, c_no, pay_status, pay_currency, pay_amount, pay_paid_amount, pay_paid_at, pay_buyer_name, pay_buyer_tel, pay_buyer_postcode, pay_address, pay_receipt_url, pay_method, pg_provider, pg_type, pay_name, error_msg, success, apply_num, bank_name, card_name, card_number, card_quota ) VALUES ( #{pay_merchant_uid}, #{pay_pg_tid}, #{pay_imp_uid}, #{pay_email}, #{c_no}, #{pay_status}, #{pay_currency}, #{pay_amount}, #{pay_paid_amount}, #{pay_paid_at}, #{pay_buyer_name}, #{pay_buyer_tel}, #{pay_buyer_postcode}, #{pay_address}, #{pay_receipt_url}, #{pay_method}, #{pg_provider}, #{pg_type}, #{pay_name}, #{error_msg}, #{success}, #{apply_num}, #{bank_name}, #{card_name}, #{card_number}, #{card_quota} )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET pay_status = COALESCE(#{pay_status}, pay_status), pay_imp_uid = COALESCE(#{pay_imp_uid}, pay_imp_uid), pay_pg_tid = COALESCE(#{pay_pg_tid}, pay_pg_tid), pay_receipt_url = COALESCE(#{pay_receipt_url}, pay_receipt_url), pay_paid_amount = COALESCE(#{pay_paid_amount}, pay_paid_amount), pay_paid_at = NOW(), pay_method = COALESCE(#{pay_method}, pay_method), apply_num = COALESCE(#{apply_num}, apply_num), card_name = COALESCE(#{card_name}, card_name), card_number = COALESCE(#{card_number}, card_number), bank_name = COALESCE(#{bank_name}, bank_name), success = COALESCE(#{success}, success), error_msg = COALESCE(#{error_msg}, error_msg) WHERE pay_merchant_uid = #{pay_merchant_uid} OR pay_imp_uid = #{pay_imp_uid}
